reason: The free first visit means I can try it with no risk, and I'm always looking for an indoor place that isn't packed for the baby and my 4-year-old. But I'd only go a couple times a month, since $13 for two kids adds up on my budget.
objection: I'll still be chasing my 10-month-old, so I won't really get to sit and drink the coffee. And $13 plus $7 for the sibling every time is real money when we're stretched.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper per-visit price for two kids, or seeing that the Baby Nook is gated enough that I can actually sit while the baby plays.
